about: What the code sprites drew before migration batch M8b redrew them as data (frozen from sprites/_was-<id>.js; review M8b round 1): `changes` lists each setting (a control at 0, 0.3, 0.8 or 1, the other toggle value, each other option) and the clips whose frames it changed from the defaults; `defaults` is each clip's first frame at the defaults (palette letters, "." see-through).
